STATUS: pass

SUMMARY: I found no reproduced blocking defect. The orchestrator's note about `?genre=POETRY` is wrong: the build already matches it case-insensitively. Remaining findings are minor, and I looked at only two of the twelve screenshots by eye.

FILES TOUCHED: none in the repo. My probes are in `/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-ff-eval-2d3td8w8-workspace/b9762f2d-4333-419a-8568-a8a04d466a0b/scratchpad/` (p1–p7.mjs, common.mjs, shot-*.png). That directory also holds files I did not create (probe-*.mjs, mut/, shots/), which I left alone. `git status` still shows the same 23 untracked entries.

FINDINGS:
- [minor] Orchestrator correction: `?genre=POETRY` loads poetry (2 of 14, select = poetry, URL canonicalised). Not a finding.
- [minor] `?genre=Nature%20writing` (display name, not slug) falls back to All. Not a criterion, but inconsistent with how the select labels the genre.
- [minor] Contact name of a zero-width space (U+200B) passes as non-empty, because JS `trim()` does not strip it. Not reproduced as a criterion failure; the criteria say "whitespace only", so this is a judgement call.
- [minor] The message counter counts UTF-16 units: 1500 emoji show "2000 of 2000 characters used" but only 1000 characters. Not reproduced as a defect.
- [minor] `a@-b.com` and `a@[1.2.3.4]` are accepted by the email pattern. Not reproduced as a defect.
- [minor] No dark colour scheme is defined in the CSS, so the "any dark scheme" contrast check has nothing to measure.
- [minor] Without JS, all seven events show under "Upcoming", including the past one. Inspected in the HTML, not run.
- [minor] Four screenshots were checked by eye: books and visit at 360px. The other ten were not viewed. Nothing in the two I viewed looked clipped or placeholder-like.

CHECKS:
- Nav: open menu, resize to 1280 → nav visible, button `aria-expanded=false`, class cleared → pass
- Nav: 21 + 20 + 7 rapid clicks → `aria-expanded` matches visibility every time → pass
- Nav: Enter opens, Tab past last item closes, Escape returns focus to toggle, Escape from a link returns focus to toggle, click outside closes → pass
- Books: 9 `?genre=` variants (POETRY, Poetry, padded, `%20`, script tag, unknown, empty, nature-writing, Nature%20writing) → correct filter or All, no console errors, no injected nodes → pass (except the minor above)
- Books: seeded property, 400 random `?genre=` strings vs trim+lowercase rule → pass. Fewer than the 1000 the rule asks for.
- Books: change → back/forward restores select, rows and URL; keyboard ArrowDown updates URL and live count "Showing 3 of 14" → pass
- Visit: 24 email variants, rejected or accepted as the regex predicts; `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` and focus on first invalid → pass
- Visit: all four empty or whitespace fields → four specific messages, summary "Please fix the 4 fields with errors.", errors clear on correction → pass
- Visit: valid double submit → demo status, no navigation, no "sent" wording → pass
- Visit: paste 10,000 chars → capped at 2000, counter "2000 of 2000" → pass
- Events: 23:30 on 23 Jan 2027 in UTC, Kiritimati and Los Angeles → event dated today is upcoming → pass
- Events: midnight 24 Jan moves the 23 Jan event to past; after the last event the "no upcoming" message shows → pass
- Events: 2026-11-17 → one past event under "Past events" → pass
- Responsive: 360, 768, 1280 on all four pages → scrollWidth equals viewport, no clipping, nav/select/button targets ≥44px → pass
- Contrast (computed, rendered backgrounds): body 16.2, muted 7.2, byline and footer 6.6, links 6.6–7.3, primary button 7.7, past-event body (opacity 0.85 applied) 4.96, field error 7.7 → pass. Focus ring (#0b5cad) is about 6.5:1 by hand estimate, not measured.
- Focus ring: solid 3px outline on the select → pass
- Reduced motion: transitions 0s, scroll-behavior auto → pass
- Network: no `http(s)://` in any HTML, CSS or JS file; no failed responses → pass
- Console and exceptions: none on any page during the probes → pass
- Money/numbers: no user-entered amounts; prices are constants shown with `toFixed(2)`. Negative zero, NaN and infinity are not applicable.
- Focus trap: the menu is not a modal, so there is no trap to test. Focus return is covered above.

OPEN QUESTIONS: none. The orchestrator should drop the POETRY finding, and decide whether the minor items matter.
